decisions.statement: This module is spawned rather than imported.
A check cannot wait for a call.
The job arrives on standard input and the answers leave on standard output.
A prompt asked more than once sits more than once in the job.
A model answers at no temperature, so one prompt asked twice answers the same.
An answer has room to set out its reasons before the answer settles.
The model is named by the caller rather than read from a family here.
A call that could not be made throws rather than answering emptily.
A job that could not be answered exits with exit code `3`.
Every way of failing leaves the same exit.
A wait the gateway asks for is the wait taken.
A status that will not come good is tried no further.
The gateway named by the environment sits between this module and Anthropic.
Nothing here judges a model's answer.

definition: prompts put to a model, each answered by the words the model writes back
